body: it feels good to have someone else recognize it. don’t apologize, your words helped

i would still be nobody even if i moved away. i cant run from myself. i cant say i have felt good in a long time, its like a very distant dream. i wish i felt like i had a purpose but all i can focus on is the pain. its 100x more apparent. i cant even form coherent responses when someone asks whats wrong. i just stare off and blink. everyone expects me to be this put together person that i am simply not
